style.name: Graphic Brutalism
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: bold graphic brutalism for global-news posters, with raw editorial grids, oversized condensed type, stark black-white-red contrast, rough paper and halftone texture, hard borders, cutout photography, blunt data blocks and deliberately imperfect but highly legible composition.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 八个信号把关税、AI、配送、冲突与健康推上同一张风险图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者要同时重算跨境成本、技术责任与外部冲击
zh-CN.headlineFull: 八个信号把关税、AI、配送、冲突与健康推上同一张风险图；经营者要同时重算跨境成本、技术责任与外部冲击
zh-CN.intro: 美加关税出现三天谈判窗口，FDA征询生成式AI医疗器械监管意见，亚马逊扩展无人机配送；加沙调查、刚果埃博拉、肯尼亚空难与银河系中心新发现共同构成今天的全球观察面。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正重要的不是热点数量，而是哪一个信号会先改变成本、责任或安全边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把世界摊成一张表，先圈出今天必须行动的格子。

en-US.headlineFact: Eight signals put tariffs, AI, delivery, conflict and health on one risk map
en-US.headlineView: operators must recalculate cross-border cost, technology responsibility and external shocks together
en-US.headlineFull: Eight signals put tariffs, AI, delivery, conflict and health on one risk map; operators must recalculate cross-border cost, technology responsibility and external shocks together
en-US.intro: A three-day US-Canada tariff window, an FDA consultation on generative-AI medical devices and Amazon's drone expansion reshape operations, while Gaza investigations, Congo Ebola, a Kenya air crash and a discovery near the galactic center define today's wider risk picture.
en-US.xiaziQuote: What matters is not the number of headlines, but which signal changes cost, responsibility or the safety boundary first.
en-US.doudouQuote: Lay the world out as a table and circle the box that needs action today.

sources.title: Trump pauses 50% Canadian tariffs for three days

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国将加拿大商品50%关税暂停三天
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家获得短暂窗口重算原产地、入境日和DDP报价
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国将加拿大商品50%关税暂停三天；卖家获得短暂窗口重算原产地、入境日和DDP报价
zh-CN.intro: 美加领导人谈判取得进展后，美国将原定生效的部分加拿大商品50%关税暂停三天；跨境卖家仍需按实际入境时间核对税则、原产地证明、承运商代垫费用和退货责任。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 三天不是风险消失，而是把错误报价改成可执行报价的窗口。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先别急着降价，等税则和入境节点都对上。

en-US.headlineFact: The US paused a 50% tariff on Canadian goods for three days
en-US.headlineView: sellers get a brief window to recalculate origin, entry date and DDP quotes
en-US.headlineFull: The US paused a 50% tariff on Canadian goods for three days; sellers get a brief window to recalculate origin, entry date and DDP quotes
en-US.intro: After progress in talks between US and Canadian leaders, Washington paused the planned 50% duty on certain Canadian goods for three days; cross-border sellers still need to verify tariff codes, origin documents, entry timing, carrier advances and return liability.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Three days does not erase the risk; it is a window to replace a wrong quote with an executable one.
en-US.doudouQuote: Do not cut the price until the tariff rule and entry point both line up.

sources.title: Trump and Canada's Carney make progress on tariff deal

zh-CN.headlineFact: FDA就生成式AI医疗器械监管公开征求意见
zh-CN.headlineView: 模型更新、临床证据与责任追踪需要进入同一套产品记录
zh-CN.headlineFull: FDA就生成式AI医疗器械监管公开征求意见；模型更新、临床证据与责任追踪需要进入同一套产品记录
zh-CN.intro: 美国食品药品监督管理局正就生成式AI医疗器械的监管方式征求反馈，焦点包括持续学习、输出可靠性、风险变化和上市后监测；开发者需要把模型版本、数据来源和人工复核做成可审计链条。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 医疗AI的竞争力不只在生成速度，更在每一次输出能否被解释、追踪和纠正。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 会更新的模型，也要有不会丢的责任记录。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: The FDA is seeking feedback on generative-AI medical-device regulation
en-US.headlineView: model updates, clinical evidence and accountability must share one product record
en-US.headlineFull: The FDA is seeking feedback on generative-AI medical-device regulation; model updates, clinical evidence and accountability must share one product record
en-US.intro: The US Food and Drug Administration is asking for input on how to regulate generative-AI-enabled medical devices, including continuous learning, output reliability, changing risk and post-market monitoring; developers need auditable model versions, data provenance and human review.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Medical AI competes not only on generation speed, but on whether every output can be explained, traced and corrected.
en-US.doudouQuote: A model that keeps updating still needs a responsibility record that never disappears.

sources.title: FDA seeks comments on regulation of generative AI-enabled medical devices

zh-CN.headlineFact: Canva与Paystack为尼日利亚中小企业提供数字工具支持
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司可把品牌制作与收款能力组合成轻量增长栈
zh-CN.headlineFull: Canva与Paystack为尼日利亚中小企业提供数字工具支持；一人公司可把品牌制作与收款能力组合成轻量增长栈
zh-CN.intro: Canva与Paystack面向尼日利亚中小企业推出支持计划，把视觉制作、数字技能与支付能力连接起来；对一人公司而言，关键不是堆叠软件，而是让获客素材、报价、收款和复购形成一条可重复流程。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 工具真正产生杠杆，是从内容到收款的每一步都能被同一个人稳定执行。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 少装一个应用，多跑通一次成交。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Canva and Paystack are supporting Nigerian small businesses with digital tools
en-US.headlineView: solo firms can combine brand creation and payments into a lightweight growth stack
en-US.headlineFull: Canva and Paystack are supporting Nigerian small businesses with digital tools; solo firms can combine brand creation and payments into a lightweight growth stack
en-US.intro: Canva and Paystack launched support for Nigerian SMBs that connects visual creation, digital skills and payment capability; for a one-person company, the goal is not more software, but a repeatable path from acquisition creative to quote, payment and retention.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Tools create leverage when one operator can reliably execute every step from content to payment.
en-US.doudouQuote: Install one less app and complete one more sale.

sources.title: Canva and Paystack empower Nigerian SMBs

zh-CN.headlineFact: 亚马逊计划将轻型包裹无人机配送扩至500座美国城市
zh-CN.headlineView: 末端速度将从营销卖点变成库存与包装标准
zh-CN.headlineFull: 亚马逊计划将轻型包裹无人机配送扩至500座美国城市；末端速度将从营销卖点变成库存与包装标准
zh-CN.intro: 亚马逊计划把轻型包裹无人机配送扩展到500座美国城市，意味着适配重量、尺寸、天气和起降条件的商品将获得新的时效层级；品牌需要重新设计包装、库存位置和交付承诺。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当配送方式改变，产品规格、仓储位置和承诺口径都会跟着改变。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 能飞得快，也要先装得下、落得稳。

en-US.headlineFact: Amazon plans to expand lightweight-package drone delivery to 500 US cities
en-US.headlineView: last-mile speed is becoming an inventory and packaging standard
en-US.headlineFull: Amazon plans to expand lightweight-package drone delivery to 500 US cities; last-mile speed is becoming an inventory and packaging standard
en-US.intro: Amazon plans to bring drone delivery for lightweight packages to 500 US cities, creating a new service tier for products that fit weight, size, weather and landing constraints; brands will need to redesign packaging, inventory placement and delivery promises.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When the delivery mode changes, product specifications, warehouse position and promise language change with it.
en-US.doudouQuote: Flying fast still starts with fitting the box and landing safely.

sources.title: Amazon to expand drone delivery to 500 US cities

zh-CN.headlineFact: 以军就欣德·拉贾布和巴勒斯坦医护人员遇害启动刑事调查
zh-CN.headlineView: 战场记录、指挥链与救援保护将接受法律核查
zh-CN.headlineFull: 以军就欣德·拉贾布和巴勒斯坦医护人员遇害启动刑事调查；战场记录、指挥链与救援保护将接受法律核查
zh-CN.intro: 以色列军方宣布对欣德·拉贾布及巴勒斯坦医护人员遇害事件启动刑事调查，案件将检视行动记录、指挥决策和救援人员保护；调查能否独立、透明并产生责任结果将成为下一步焦点。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 调查的价值不在宣布本身，而在证据是否完整、责任是否能沿指挥链追踪。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 记录留下来，真相才有机会走进法庭。

en-US.headlineFact: Israel opened criminal probes into the killings of Hind Rajab and Palestinian paramedics
en-US.headlineView: battlefield records, command decisions and rescue protections face legal scrutiny
en-US.headlineFull: Israel opened criminal probes into the killings of Hind Rajab and Palestinian paramedics; battlefield records, command decisions and rescue protections face legal scrutiny
en-US.intro: The Israeli military announced criminal investigations into the deaths of Hind Rajab and Palestinian paramedics, putting operational records, command decisions and protections for rescuers under review; independence, transparency and accountable outcomes are now the central tests.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The value of an investigation is not its announcement, but whether evidence is complete and responsibility can be traced through command.
en-US.doudouQuote: When records survive, truth has a chance to reach the courtroom.

sources.title: Israeli military launches criminal probes into killings of Hind Rajab and Palestinian paramedics

zh-CN.headlineFact: 刚果埃博拉病例突破5000例并继续快于响应速度
zh-CN.headlineView: 追踪、隔离、治疗和社区信任必须同步扩容
zh-CN.headlineFull: 刚果埃博拉病例突破5000例并继续快于响应速度；追踪、隔离、治疗和社区信任必须同步扩容
zh-CN.intro: 刚果埃博拉疫情报告病例达到5000例，传播速度继续给接触者追踪、实验室检测、隔离床位和社区沟通带来压力；控制窗口取决于一线能力能否比新增传播链扩张得更快。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 数字越过5000只是表象，真正的赛跑是响应能力能否超过传播速度。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 每接上一条追踪链，就少一条看不见的传播链。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：刚果埃博拉。

en-US.headlineFact: Congo's Ebola outbreak passed 5,000 cases and is still outpacing response
en-US.headlineView: tracing, isolation, treatment and community trust must scale together
en-US.headlineFull: Congo's Ebola outbreak passed 5,000 cases and is still outpacing response; tracing, isolation, treatment and community trust must scale together
en-US.intro: Reported cases in Congo's Ebola outbreak have reached 5,000, continuing to pressure contact tracing, laboratories, isolation capacity and community communication; control depends on frontline capability expanding faster than new transmission chains.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Passing 5,000 is the visible number; the real race is whether response capacity can outrun transmission.
en-US.doudouQuote: Every tracing chain connected removes one invisible chain of spread.

sources.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases as response struggles

zh-CN.headlineFact: 肯尼亚直升机坠毁造成7人死亡，其中5人为美国人
zh-CN.headlineView: 事故调查将聚焦飞行条件、维护记录与航线风险
zh-CN.headlineFull: 肯尼亚直升机坠毁造成7人死亡，其中5人为美国人；事故调查将聚焦飞行条件、维护记录与航线风险
zh-CN.intro: 一架直升机在肯尼亚坠毁，机上7人全部遇难，其中包括5名美国人和一名电视媒体高管；当地与国际关注将转向天气、飞行计划、机务记录和事故现场证据。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 空难之后最重要的不是猜测原因，而是保护证据并让调查链完整运转。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先让事实落地，再让答案起飞。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：肯尼亚空难。

en-US.headlineFact: Seven people, including five Americans, died in a Kenya helicopter crash
en-US.headlineView: investigators will focus on flight conditions, maintenance records and route risk
en-US.headlineFull: Seven people, including five Americans, died in a Kenya helicopter crash; investigators will focus on flight conditions, maintenance records and route risk
en-US.intro: A helicopter crashed in Kenya, killing all seven people aboard, including five Americans and a television executive; attention now turns to weather, flight planning, maintenance history and preservation of evidence at the site.
en-US.xiaziQuote: After an air crash, the priority is not guessing the cause but protecting evidence and keeping the investigation chain intact.
en-US.doudouQuote: Let the facts land before the answers take off.

sources.title: Five Americans among seven killed in Kenya helicopter crash

zh-CN.headlineFact: 科学家追踪到绕银河系中心黑洞高速运行的恒星
zh-CN.headlineView: 极端轨道为检验引力与黑洞环境提供新标尺
zh-CN.headlineFull: 科学家追踪到绕银河系中心黑洞高速运行的恒星；极端轨道为检验引力与黑洞环境提供新标尺
zh-CN.intro: 天文学家研究一颗在银河系中心超大质量黑洞附近高速运行的恒星，它的紧密轨道让研究人员能够观察强引力环境，并进一步检验恒星运动、黑洞质量和相对论效应。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 越靠近极端环境，轨道就越像一把测量宇宙规则的精密尺。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 跑得越快的星星，留下的数据越有分量。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：银河系中心。

en-US.headlineFact: Scientists tracked a high-speed star orbiting the black hole at the Milky Way's center
en-US.headlineView: an extreme orbit offers a new ruler for gravity and the black-hole environment
en-US.headlineFull: Scientists tracked a high-speed star orbiting the black hole at the Milky Way's center; an extreme orbit offers a new ruler for gravity and the black-hole environment
en-US.intro: Astronomers are studying a star racing close to the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way; its tight orbit lets researchers probe strong gravity and refine tests of stellar motion, black-hole mass and relativistic effects.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The closer an orbit comes to an extreme environment, the more precisely it measures the rules of the universe.
en-US.doudouQuote: The faster the star, the more weight its data can carry.

sources.title: High-speed star whips around the black hole in the middle of our galaxy
